name: Guardian Portrait
condition_immunities: Charmed; Exhaustion; Frightened; Grappled; Paralyzed; Petrified; Poisoned; Prone; Restrained
languages: plus up to two other languages

special_abilities.name: Constructed Nature
special_abilities.desc: An animated object doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep. The magic that animates an object is dispelled when the construct drops to 0 hit points. An animated object reduced to 0 hit points becomes inanimate and is too damaged to be of much use or value to anyone.

special_abilities.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
special_abilities.desc: The portrait is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the portrait must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or become unconscious for 1 minute.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While the figure in the portrait remains motionless, the portrait is indistinguishable from a normal painting.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc: The portrait's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 12). The portrait can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: 3/day each: counterspell, crown of madness, hypnotic pattern, telekinesis
